[
مُضَرِّعٌ part. n. of the intrans. verb ضَرَّعَ. ―
-b2- In the TA, voce كَثْءٌ, مصرع, which is evidently a mistranscription for مُضَرِّعٌ, is expl. as an epithet applied to a preparation of أَقِط (q. v.) as meaning Such as has become thick, or coagulated, and almost thoroughly cooked: on the authority of AHát.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
